[[Stoneherder's Flatbow]] is a [[unique]] [[bow]] dropped by [[Drago Stoneherder]], a [[boss]] who is found in [[Sorrow's Furnace]].

==Stats==
:[[Piercing damage]]: 15-28 (Requires 9 [[Marksmanship]])
:[[Damage]] +15% (while [[Health]] is above 50%)
:[[Energy]] gain on hit: 1
:[[Energy regeneration]] -1
:[[Health]] +30

==Replica==

*One of the following [[flatbow]]s:
**[[Feathered Flatbow]] from collectors [[Rahvu]], [[Pathfinder Alon]], or [[Pekk]] or crafters [[Aksah]], [[Asiri]], [[Hahbe]] or [[Kol Swordshanks]]
**[[Flatbow]] from collectors [[Ohtah]] or [[Guard Captain Mirkoz]]
**[[Destroyer Flatbow]] from crafter [[Balthor Coalforge]]
**[[Imperial Flatbow]] from collector [[Shen Xi]]
**[[Tormented Flatbow]] from collector [[Deacon of Whispers]]
*[[Zealous]] [[Bow String]]
*[[Perfect]] [[Bow Grip]] [[of Fortitude]]
OR
*One of the following [[flatbow]]s:
**[[Feathered Flatbow]] from crafters [[Asa]], [[Bolereh]], [[Derrick]], [[Hadusi]], [[Rahmdah]], [[Sende]], [[Shausha]], [[Soros]], or [[Tehshan]]
**[[Asuran Flatbow]] from crafter [[Nojj]]

==Unique counterparts==
*[[Deldrimor Flatbow (unique)]], [[Forgotten Flatbow]], and [[Ironwing Flatbow (unique)]] have stats identical to this item.
*[[Inallay's Hornbow]], [[Mallyx's Recurve Bow]], and [[Xalnax's Destiny]] have stats identical to this item; however, they are different bow classes.
